author: kirubaharan181
description: Audits policy, quality, security, access, change, vendor and cost governance. Use when overseeing controls. Do NOT use to do the audited work.
purpose: Provides independent oversight across the engineering organization: governance of engineering, quality, security, access, compliance, documentation, change, vendors and cost, and process improvement. It owns stages 181-190 and verifies controls from system evidence rather than from descriptions.
when_to_use: Policies need turning into testable controls and measured compliance.
An audit, access review or vendor review is needed.
Governance gaps need owners, dates and verified closure.
when_not_to_use: Doing the audited work itself: use the specialist skill.
Approving a production change: use secure-change-control.
Setting up one repository: use engineering-governance.
prerequisites: Read access to the evidence the review needs.
A control framework or policy set.
No external API keys, paid services or network access are required; work uses files and tools already approved in the repository.
outputs: compliance or audit report with samples

decision_rules.action: Rewrite it as testable or drop it.
Add expiry and a renewal decision.
Reduce scope formally or request access.

quality_gates: Evidence comes from systems, not descriptions

examples.title: Review access
examples.request: Run a quarterly access review for the production database.
examples.context: Role list and an access export are available.
examples.behavior: Compare actual access with approved roles, flag excess, and require owner confirmation.
examples.output: Access review report with removals and owners.
examples.acceptance: Every excess access has an owner decision.

examples.title: Audit change records
examples.request: Check that production deployments have change records.
examples.context: A month of deployments is available.
examples.behavior: Reconcile deployments to records and list gaps.
examples.output: Reconciliation with 6 of 410 unrecorded deployments and actions.
examples.acceptance: Each gap has an owner and a fix date.

limitations: Findings reflect only the evidence provided and the period sampled.
Does not certify compliance with any standard.
Risk acceptance is decided by a named human.

troubleshooting.resolution: Sample by risk and state the sampling method.
